rv.q: We all know that Santa brings joy to children all over the world at Christmas, but he always works so hard that he doesn’t have time to celebrate himself. This year, his kind elves decide to give him the best Christmas ever. It’s a delightful premise, suggesting a cheerful story full of magic and sparkle.
Beautifully choreographed, musically engaging and genuinely heartwarming, this festive production reminds us that those who spend their lives caring for others deserve to be cared for, too.
